title: Zesty Charred Russian Chicken Wings Tagine
description: A spicy and savory Russian dish featuring charred chicken wings cooked in a tagine pot, perfect for a hangover cure. This sugar-free friendly recipe is made with a stone bowl dolsot for a unique presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the chicken wings and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and char the chicken wings for 5 minutes on each side.
Transfer the chicken wings to a tagine pot and add lemon juice and chicken broth.
Cover the tagine pot with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes to crisp the skin.
Serve the chicken wings hot in the stone bowl dolsot.
